`final class DrawShape`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.draw.shape` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DrawShape.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/draw/shape/DrawShape.java)

Draws filled and outlined shapes, lines and curves with a `Color`, sharp at every scale.

## Description

Reach it through `DrawUtils.SHAPE`.
Positions and sizes are in design pixels, in the coordinates you draw in; every method accepts a gradient or an animated [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/).
Edges stay sharp by themselves: on the pixel grid they snap to whole pixels, and under a rotation or a fractional scale they are smoothed, so no method has a thin or smooth variant.
A rectangle without width or height draws nothing.

## Method details

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawRect"></a>

### drawRect

`void drawRect(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color)` 

Fills the rectangle at `x`, `y` of `width` × `height`.
A rectangle thinner than one screen pixel draws with its coverage as opacity, so a hairline stays visible.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawRoundedRect"></a>

### drawRoundedRect

`void drawRoundedRect(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color, float radius)` 

Fills the rectangle with its four corners rounded by `radius`.
The radius is capped at half the shorter side, so `999F` draws a pill.

`void drawRoundedRect(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color, float radius, boolean roundedLeft, boolean roundedTop, boolean roundedRight, boolean roundedBottom)` 

Fills the rectangle and rounds only some corners, with one `boolean` per side: `roundedLeft`, `roundedTop`, `roundedRight` and `roundedBottom`.
A corner is rounded when both of its sides are: `true, true, true, false` keeps the bottom corners square.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawRoundedBorder"></a>

### drawRoundedBorder

`void drawRoundedBorder(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color, float radius)` 

Strokes the outline of the rounded rectangle, 1 design pixel wide, inside its edge.

`void drawRoundedBorder(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color, float radius, double stroke)` 

Strokes the outline of the rounded rectangle, `stroke` design pixels wide, inside its edge.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawShadow"></a>

### drawShadow

`void drawShadow(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color, float radius, float blur)` 

Draws the soft shadow of a rounded box: the box at `x`, `y` of `width` × `height` with corner `radius`, blurred by `blur` design pixels.
The shadow spreads 1.5 times the blur beyond the box; a `blur` of `0F` or less draws a plain rounded rectangle.
A gradient color uses its start color.

`void drawShadow(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color, float radius, boolean roundedLeft, boolean roundedTop, boolean roundedRight, boolean roundedBottom, float blur)` 

Draws the soft shadow of a box whose corners are rounded only on the chosen sides, as in `drawRoundedRect`, blurred by `blur` design pixels.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawCircle"></a>

### drawCircle

`void drawCircle(double x, double y, Color color, double radius)` 

Fills the disc centered on `x`, `y` with the given `radius`.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawBorder"></a>

### drawBorder

`void drawBorder(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color)` 

Strokes a border 1 design pixel wide inside the rectangle at `x`, `y` of `width` × `height`.
It covers the same pixels as `drawRoundedBorder` with a radius of `0F`.

`void drawBorder(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color, double stroke)` 

Strokes a border `stroke` design pixels wide inside the rectangle.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawPolygon"></a>

### drawPolygon

`void drawPolygon(Color color, Point... points)` 

Fills the polygon through `points`, in order; a convex polygon gets smoothed edges.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawLine"></a>

### drawLine

`void drawLine(Color color, Point... points)` 

Draws a smoothed line through `points`, in order, with the line width of the render state, in design pixels.

`void drawLine(Color color, float stroke, Point... points)` 

Draws a smoothed line through `points`, `stroke` design pixels wide.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawDashedLine"></a>

### drawDashedLine

`void drawDashedLine(Color color, int pattern, float stroke, Point... points)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The dash pattern … is not positive, pass a length above 0

Draws a dashed line through `points`, `stroke` design pixels wide: dashes of `pattern` design pixels separated by gaps of the same length, restarted at each point.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when `pattern` is 0 or less.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawCurvedLine"></a>

### drawCurvedLine

`void drawCurvedLine(Color color, Point start, Point control, Point end)` 

Draws a quadratic Bézier curve from `start` to `end`, pulled toward `control`, in about one segment per design pixel of its length.

`void drawCurvedLine(Color color, float stroke, Point start, Point control, Point end)` 

Draws the quadratic Bézier curve `stroke` design pixels wide.

`void drawCurvedLine(Color color, Point start, Point startControl, Point endControl, Point end)` 

Draws a cubic Bézier curve from `start` to `end`, shaped by `startControl` and `endControl`.

`void drawCurvedLine(Color color, float stroke, Point start, Point startControl, Point endControl, Point end)` 

Draws the cubic Bézier curve `stroke` design pixels wide.

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawShape"></a>

### drawShape

`void drawShape(DrawMode mode, Color color, Point... points)` 

Draws `points` as the primitive that `mode` names, such as [`DrawMode.LINES`](/reference/drawing/drawmode/#DrawMode-value-LINES) or [`DrawMode.POLYGON`](/reference/drawing/drawmode/#DrawMode-value-POLYGON).

<a id="DrawShape-method-drawRawRect"></a>

### drawRawRect

`void drawRawRect(double x, double y, double width, double height)` 

Fills the rectangle with the current color of the render state, without a texture and without edge smoothing.
Use it inside a shader pass or a mask, where the color comes from elsewhere.
